## Ranked Top 3 Recommendations (Why They Made the Cut & Tradeoffs)

### #1. Maya Deluxe Velvet Faux Wrap Maxi Dress in Emerald Green (John Lewis – £75.00)
- **Why It's the Single Best Buy:** 
  Buying a dress as a gift when you're not 100% certain of exact body proportions or style preferences is notoriously risky. A faux-wrap A-line silhouette with soft flutter sleeves and a crossover V-neck is the universally recognized gold standard in flattering womenswear. In size 12, this cut accommodates varied bust sizes and hip shapes without clinging or gaping. The plush emerald velvet gives it an immediate sense of tactile birthday luxury that feels far more expensive than £75. Backed by John Lewis's gold-standard 30-day return policy (returnable for free at hundreds of local Waitrose/John Lewis stores or by post) and free standard shipping, the buying risk is virtually zero.
- **Key Tradeoffs:** 
  Velvet is naturally a cooler-weather fabric (ideal for autumn, winter, or evening venues, but too heavy for outdoor summer heat). As a maxi, if your sister is under 5'4", she will likely need 2–3 inch heels or light hemming to avoid floor brush.

### #2. Vila Satin Cowl Neck Cami Maxi Dress in Dark Green (ASOS – £40.00)
- **Why It's the Strongest Backup #1:** 
  If your sister loves modern, sexy, 90s-inspired aesthetics or is planning a trendy birthday dinner with cocktails, this is an unbeatable choice. At just £40, it has 30 verified customer reviews averaging a solid 3.9/5 stars, qualifying for free ASOS delivery and hassle-free 28-day returns. The bias cut allows the satin to skim the body rather than squeeze it, and the deep jewel "Scarab" green catches night-time lighting beautifully.
- **Key Tradeoffs:** 
  The cowl neck and thin spaghetti straps require either a backless/strapless bra or adhesive covers. The slinky bias-cut satin is unforgiving of visible undergarment lines compared to velvet or structured crepe, and it requires careful steaming or low-heat ironing.

### #3. Coast Pleat Detail Lace Trim Maxi Dress in Green (Coast Fashion – £50.00, Was £129.00)
- **Why It's the Strongest Backup #2:** 
  This dress represents the highest percentage discount (61% off) on a high-end British occasionwear brand. The empire silhouette with delicate lace trim draws the eye upward to the narrowest part of the torso, while the micro-pleating and sheer billowing sleeves provide graceful arm coverage for sisters who dislike sleeveless cuts. It feels romantic, polished, and modest yet celebratory.
- **Key Tradeoffs:** 
  Coast charges a £1.99 return postage fee if sent back by post. The floor-grazing length will require heels for anyone under 5'6".
